items.title: Every fppf covering is refined by a locally quasi-finite flat finite presentation covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given an fppf covering of a scheme S, the lemma produces a refining fppf covering all of whose maps are locally quasi-finite, i.e. the locally quasi-finite flat finite presentation maps already generate the fppf topology. The retained proof is written out: for each s in S pick an index i with s in the image of S_i -> S, apply the neighbourhood lemma (lemma-qf-fp-flat-neighbourhood-dominates-fppf) to get a map g_s : T_s -> S that is flat, locally of finite presentation, locally quasi-finite, has s in its image and factors through S_i -> S, and verify the resulting family {T_s -> S} is an fppf covering refining the original one. Retained author proof at lines 6476-6484.
